title: Sea Salt
meta_description: Coastal charm meets comfort at Sea Salt by AvantStay --- your serene 30A retreat near the beach.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Sea Salt by AvantStay!

Tucked within the private, gated community of Cypress Dunes in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida, Sea Salt is a serene three-story coastal retreat where sophisticated comfort meets the soul of the Gulf Coast. Just minutes from the turquoise waters and sugar-white sands of 30A, this spacious haven blends relaxed beachside living with the elevated amenities of a resort-style getaway and effortless access via Scenic Highway 30A and County Road 393.

Step inside to airy, light-filled interiors designed for connection and comfort. The open-concept living space features plush reclining sofas, a large smart TV, and a cozy fireplace---perfect for winding down after a sun-soaked day. The adjacent dining area---with seating for eight---flows into a modern, fully equipped kitchen stocked with everything needed for effortless group meals or sunset cocktails.

Each of the four bedrooms is thoughtfully curated for rest and privacy. The primary suite boasts a king bed and spa-style ensuite with a walk-in shower, while the remaining rooms offer a queen, a double, and a bunk room kids will adore. A queen sleeper sofa in the common area provides flexible space for larger groups.

Outside, unwind on the screened porch with your morning coffee or gather around the backyard firepit beneath a canopy of stars. As a guest of Cypress Dunes, you'll have access to two stunning resort-style pools---including the community's signature infinity pool overlooking the Gulf and Topsail Hill Preserve, plus a second family-friendly pool ideal for relaxed afternoons. Enjoy the tennis and pickleball courts, fitness center, clubhouse, and scenic boardwalk trails, or step directly onto the Timpoochee Trail for biking and leisurely coastal strolls.

With 30A gems like Grayton Beach, Seaside, and Blue Mountain Beach just a short drive or bike ride away, Sea Salt places you close to the best dining, boutique shopping, and outdoor adventures along the Emerald Coast. Travel is simple: rideshare-friendly pickups, nearby regional airports (ECP and VPS), and direct routes make arrivals and day trips effortless. Whether you're here to recharge, reconnect, or simply breathe in the salt air, this luxury home is your perfect escape.

AvantStay provides an upscale experience with services that elevate your stay and save time so you can enjoy every moment. Guests have access to a 24/7 support team and a tech-enabled concierge to book services, such as fridge stocking, mid-stay cleanings, and private chefs. For anything you need (or never knew you needed), we're at your service!

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: Red Fish Taco, Blue Mountain Bakery, Blue Mountain Creamery, Cowgirl Kitchen Market \& Cafe, Mimmo's 30a Ristorante Italiano.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- A Pack 'n Play is available for guest use.

Parking Details:
- Driveway parking available for up to 2 cars.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
